event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - database lookups outside duties

summary: An Alberta Correctional Services probation officer was charged with breach of trust and unauthorized use of a computer after allegedly accessing protected government databases outside the scope of her duties to obtain confidential information. Calgary police were notified of the improper access on January 22, 2026 and executed a search warrant on her electronic devices on April 30, 2026.
